methods.explanation: Multiplying both sides by 6 (note that the 1 on the right must also be multiplied by 6) gives \(3(x-1)-2(2x+1)=6\), yielding \(3x-3-4x-2=6\), or \(-x-5=6\), so \(x=-11\).
